description: Dept. of Elections - Elected Mr. Udahawiyannalage Sanjaya Senevirathna as a member of the Warakapola Pradesiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Warakapola Pradeshiya Sabha) due to the death of a member, under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It details the process of nominating and declaring a new member elected, which falls squarely under electoral processes and matters related to local authority elections.
